item.title: LIST: Celebrate Black History Month at these events across the Las Vegas valley

item.title: 2 dead after downtown Las Vegas apartment complex stabbing
item.description: Two people were killed in a stabbing incident at a downtown Las Vegas apartment building Monday night, after the suspect was detained by witnesses and stabbed with his own knife.

item.title: CPS finds North Las Vegas teacher hit autistic student
item.description: An investigation from Clark County Family Services determined that a Clark County School District teacher hit a special needs student, despite the district's investigation determining the assault was "unsubstantiated."

item.title: Country bar at Durango, Sunset Station projects, but Stations still silent on next big resort
item.description: Famed country bar Moonshine Flats is coming to Durango Casino & Resort, officials announced on Tuesday, along with details for the second phase of renovations at Sunset Station. But they remained tight-lipped about the next locals project.
